scope: Static review of v7 contract, feature generator, runner, supervisor and controller against v7 prompt and recorded experiment history; not a complete independent validation
execution: No VM call or training in this review

findings.evidence: real_audit_approved and resolved were true despite no resolved business justification for all 14 October masks. External historical source incorrectly elevated to authority.
Nine masks were retained without fresh semantic justification in v7; historical official_confirmation was false. Dataset all-zero evidence alone does not establish cause.
findings.action: Review all nine with dictionary and month-variable statistics; do not silently treat inherited as confirmed.

findings.evidence: Initial all-finite-zero hypothesis was false. Mixed zeros/nonzeros does not prove correct measurement either. Preserving July is provisional, not evidence that there is no defect.
findings.action: Retain raw data; document anomaly and defer any transformation.

findings.evidence: materialize records null fraction by month but does not separate absent client-month, original missing, sanitation and formula-induced missing as required by prompt section 5.
findings.action: Implement and validate provenance report before approval; no claim current matrix audit fully satisfies prompt.

findings.issue: Early worker failures bypass local shutdown
findings.evidence: Lock acquisition, existing-output check, sudo check and deadline validation occur before worker try/finally. Failed worker can leave VM running until OS/provider cap.
findings.action: Fix startup failure handling without shutting down a different active experiment; test failure paths before launch.

findings.evidence: Backup creation has no separate deadline; Cloud Shell connection or 90-second transfers can fail. Provider STOP caps runtime but does not ensure off-VM recovery.
findings.action: Record backup success only after remote and local verification; plan recovery without auto-restarting.

findings.evidence: Controller imports installed packages; runner logs five package versions after startup. No enforced complete dependency lock, despite prompt requiring environment frozen before fitting.
findings.action: Capture VM environment read-only and freeze/validate compatible dependency versions before training.

findings.evidence: Synthetic tests, hashes and regenerated predictions are not independent full-dataset training reproduction.
findings.action: Separate explicitly; full rerun not performed or budgeted here.

findings.evidence: Five seeds do not establish temporal robustness; August used in tuning/cuts; conditional bootstrap does not cover tuning uncertainty or prior October exploration.
findings.action: Existing runner labels exploratory and conditional appropriately; keep those limits in report.

findings.issue: Controller did not check review flags before Cloud actions
findings.evidence: Runner checks flags, but Cloud Shell controller previously did not check them before starting VM.
findings.action: Fixed: explicit launch gate before manifest/audit discovery or Cloud actions; regression test added.
